title: Capturing Error Messages

theory.title: Exercise 3.2.2: Capturing Error Messages
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "Knowing THAT an error occurred isn't enough. We need to know WHAT the error was. That's where 'AS' comes in."

EXCEPT AS - Capturing Error Details

Use AS to capture the error message in a variable:

TRY
    Risky Operation
EXCEPT    AS    ${error}
    Log    The error was: ${error}
END

What Gets Captured:

  • The error message text (e.g., from Fail keyword)
  • The error type (if different exceptions)
  • Full error details for logging/debugging

Example: Logging Error Details

TRY
    Log    Connecting to navigation system...
    Fail    Connection refused: port 5000 unreachable
EXCEPT    AS    ${error_msg}
    Log    Navigation error: ${error_msg}
    Log    Retrying with backup connection...
END

Output:

Connecting to navigation system...
Navigation error: Connection refused: port 5000 unreachable
Retrying with backup connection...

⚠️ EXCEPT AS Tips

  • Variable can be any valid name: ${error}, ${err}, ${exception}
  • Error message includes text from Fail or other failures
  • Variable only exists within EXCEPT block scope
  • Useful for conditional logic based on error content
  • Great for debugging and diagnostic logging
